name: IOIPG
recent: IOIPG 近期推进 IOIPG REIT 上市，IPO 发售价下调至 91 仙，公众部分超额认购 0.59 倍。公司于 11 月 6 日召开第 14 届常年股东大会，所有普通决议获通过。同期，集团首席执行官 Dato' Lee Yeow Seng 在公开市场增持公司股份，并辞去 IOI Corp 非执行董事职务以专注领导 IOIPG。
notable: IOIPG REIT 的 IPO 发售价下调至每股 91 仙，公众发售部分超额认购 0.59 倍。
第 14 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 11 月 6 日举行，所有普通决议均获股东通过。
集团首席执行官 Dato' Lee Yeow Seng 于 2026 年 11 月 5 日和 6 日分别在公开市场增持 300 万股公司股份。
risks: Dato' Lee Yeow Seng 于 2026 年 11 月 6 日辞去 IOI Corp 非执行董事职务。
公司于 2026 年 11 月 12 日、11 月 3 日及 10 月 28 日发布多项提案公告，具体内容未在资料中详述。

recent_en: IOIPG is progressing the listing of IOIPG REIT, with the IPO price lowered to 91 sen and the public tranche oversubscribed 0.59 times. The company held its 14th AGM on 6 November, where all ordinary resolutions were passed. Meanwhile, Group CEO Dato' Lee Yeow Seng acquired shares in the open market and resigned as non-executive director of IOI Corp to focus on leading IOIPG.
notable_en: The IPO price for IOIPG REIT was lowered to 91 sen per unit, with the public tranche oversubscribed 0.59 times.
The 14th AGM was held on 6 November 2026, and all ordinary resolutions were passed by shareholders.
Group CEO Dato' Lee Yeow Seng acquired 3 million shares each on 5 and 6 November 2026 in the open market.
risks_en: Dato' Lee Yeow Seng resigned as non-executive director of IOI Corp on 6 November 2026.
The company issued multiple proposals announcements on 12 November, 3 November, and 28 October 2026, with details not specified in the provided materials.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 1,386,789,000, up 32.4% QoQ and 55.8% YoY; net income was MYR 523,111,000, up 102.7% QoQ but down 36.5% YoY; net margin was 37.7%, higher than 24.6% in the previous quarter.
